name: EXM_CASH_ADV_APPLICATIONS
description: EXM_CASH_ADV_APPLICATIONS table stores detailed inoformation of cash advance applications.

columns.name: CASH_ADV_APP_ID
columns.description: Surrogate ID key.

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.

columns.name: REVERSAL_CASH_ADV_APP_ID
columns.description: Used to store the cash advance application id which is reversed.

columns.name: CASH_ADVANCE_ID
columns.description: Cash Advance ID.

columns.name: EXPENSE_REPORT_ID
columns.description: Expense Report ID

columns.name: AMOUNT
columns.description: Amount applied to the expense report.

columns.name: CURRENCY_CODE
columns.description: Currency code for the amount applied to expense report.

columns.name: EXCHANGE_RATE
columns.description: Exchange rate used for applying cash advance to expense report.

columns.name: EXCHANGE_RATE_TYPE
columns.description: Exchange rate type used for applying cash advance to expense report.

columns.name: APPLIED_DATE
columns.description: Date on which the cash advance was applied. Should be same as the day when the expense report was submitted.

columns.name: REQUEST_ID
columns.description: Enterprise Service Scheduler: indicates the request ID of the job that created or last updated the row.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: APPLIED_METHOD_CODE
columns.description: Indicates the code of the method used to apply cash advance

columns.name: REVERSAL_REASON_CODE
columns.description: Indicates the code of the reason for reversal of cash advance.

columns.name: REVERSAL_GROUP_ID
columns.description: Identifier of the group of cash advances that are associated with a report or are reversed. Group Id is null for all active applications.

columns.name: ADJUSTED_AMOUNT
columns.description: Amount adjusted by the auditor.
